personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean with 6 Glass / Luxe premium finishes
personality_one_liner: Order, trust, and financial precision delivered through clean typography and a premium dark-navy hero experience.

spacing.rule: Handle spacing correctly dont have extra spaces where its not required, handle padding and margin corectly and subtle for buttons and components

do's: Use on sticky headers over scrolling content
Use on hero cards placed over the navy background
dont's: Don't use on standard form inputs

screens.name: Splash
screens.purpose: First impression conveying privacy and financial control.

states.loading: Show original logo and custom graphic symbol on navy background with mint details

screens.layout: Full bleed navy (#0B1528) background. Center the Subly wordmark and custom subscription graphic symbol. Mint green subtle accents or progress indicator. Minimalist, premium feel.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Provide a high-priority summary of monthly spend, upcoming payments, and alert statuses.

states.loading: Centered spinner over navy hero area
states.empty: Mint abstract illustration with prompt to add first service
states.error: Clear message to retry data fetch

screens.layout: Top section (navy hero area extending behind the header): Monthly spend, upcoming renewal count, and overdue alert chips. Main body (overlapping the hero area with glassmorphism or white cards): Subscription list sorted by next billing date with category chips. Secondary area: Horizontal calendar scroll for expirations and a pie/bar chart for category distribution. Bottom right: Quick add FAB.

screens.name: ServiceList
screens.purpose: CRUD interface for all subscriptions and services with robust filtering.

states.empty: Illustration indicating no services match the current filter

screens.layout: Header with search bar and filter chips (Active, Paused, Free Trial). List layout: Each row features the service logo/icon in a tinted container, name, billing frequency, and next payment date. Use clear semantic colors for statuses (e.g., green for paid, orange for soon, red for overdue).

screens.name: ServiceDetail
screens.purpose: Deep dive into a specific service, payment history, and manual exchange rate settings.
screens.layout: Cover banner with service-branded color or dark navy. Title section with logo. Details card: Frequency, Category, State, Cost, and equivalent in main currency. Payment History list. Actions: Edit, Mark Paid, Cancel.

screens.name: Paywall
screens.purpose: Convert users to the premium plan (US$2/mo or annual) with a clean, trust-building presentation.
screens.layout: Hero/value headline: 'Tus pagos, bajo control.' Short supporting copy with 3 benefit bullets. Plan cards: Show monthly and annual (annual visually emphasized/pre-selected). Trust signals near the bottom (Cancel anytime, 7-day free trial). Single prominent mint green CTA: 'Start free trial'. Close icon in top right.

hero_background.alt: Dark navy blue minimalist abstract texture

empty_state_illustration.alt: Mint green soft abstract empty state

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a premium 'iOS-Native Clean' architecture infused with 'Glass / Luxe' elevated finishes.
Limit to 4 tabs max: Dashboard, Services, Calendar, Settings.
Use 'PlusJakartaSans' for a clean, modern, tabular numeric feel essential for a finance app.
The primary color is explicitly dark navy (#0B1528) and action is mint green (#059669) as specifically requested by the user. Do not use generic AI purples/blues.
The Dashboard must have a navy hero area at the top holding the summary metrics, with content cards overlapping it (with glass effect on iOS) to create depth.
Ensure 'Tus pagos, bajo control.' and other UI copy is in Spanish (Argentina) as specified.
Implement an explicit paywall pattern: Hero value proposition, 2 plan cards (Annual pre-selected), trust text, and a sticky bottom mint green CTA for the 7-day trial.
Avoid emojis entirely in the UI. Use a professional, clean icon set (Ionicons).
For service list items, default to real logo PNGs. If unavailable, use a `brandTertiary` rounded square container for initials/icons.
Ensure Loading, Empty, and Error states exist for every data-fetching screen and occupy flex: 1 with centered layout.
